name: client-kickoff
title: {{client.name}} kickoff
audience: A newly signed BigOrange client at the first working session.

slides.title: {{vars.coverTitle}}
slides.notes: Welcome. Say what today decides: owners, first sprint, and how we will measure.

slides.title: Names, roles, and who to call
slides.notes: Confirm one accountable owner on each side. Write the names down.

slides.title: {{vars.heardTitle}}

card.title: This is a draft of your priorities
card.body: If any of this is wrong or missing, say so now. The plan on the next slides follows from this list.

slides.notes: Read the bullets back and pause. Let them correct us.

slides.title: What we agreed to build
slides.notes: Read the proposal back as milestones. Anything not on this table is a change request.

slides.title: Draft, review, release, verify

data.bar: Nothing goes public without a named release owner on your side.

slides.notes: This is the safety rail. It is also why we need a reviewer named today.

slides.title: What we will report, and what we will not claim
slides.notes: Ask who will label leads accepted or not. Without that we cannot connect marketing to revenue.

slides.title: Role-based, revocable, read-only first
slides.notes: Never passwords in email. Role-based invitations only.

slides.title: {{vars.first30Title}}
slides.notes: Keep it concrete. Each week has a visible output.

slides.title: {{vars.decisionsTitle}}

data.takeaway: The goal is a named owner, a first sprint, and a measurement contract.

slides.notes: Close by assigning owners and the first dates.

slides.title: Next touchpoint
slides.notes: Confirm the next meeting date before anyone leaves.
